description: Two players: a survival player in a pit into which fire, lava and water are set and under which a magma block replaces the netherrack floor: fire taken away after two hurts and once she burns, her burning, fire resistance and resistance II in fire, an iron helmet, a diamond chestplate and netherite boots against fire, a magma block (sneaking on it too) and lava, water putting her out, burning to death after lava and rain putting her out; the other, in creative mode, stands in fire; each step's health, damage events, velocity, entity statuses, effects, slot changes and equipment, both players' shared flags, sounds (but block fall sounds and the splash into water) and death messages; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
